criteria.statement: No Agentic SDD path may grant autonomous commit, push, merge, PR, deployment, destructive infrastructure, or remote tracker mutation authority.
criteria.verification_hint: Inspect provider prompts/control-plane APIs and run safe-command/eval tests; verify no remote-write action exists in harness paths.

criteria.statement: Untrusted tracker/tool/runtime text must remain evidence-only and cannot alter accepted policy, write surfaces, verification commands, sandbox/network authority, or AC/VC criteria.
criteria.verification_hint: Classify representative paths, tamper protocol-v4 context_trust and assert runner rejects the packet.

criteria.statement: Discovery history must remain auditable: research may produce fact/evidence without a fake decision, superseded knowledge is preserved, and map clearance cannot occur with open fog or active blocking assumptions.
criteria.verification_hint: Run Wayfinder unit tests for research ledger entries, supersession, blocking assumptions and reconciliation.

criteria.statement: A required verification contract cannot be silently weakened by its author: at least one independent criterion is required and any accepted exemption requires explicit human approval.
criteria.verification_hint: Run verification-contract tests for missing/stale contracts and agent self-approval rejection.

criteria.statement: Risk-driven red-green builder completion is rejected unless the agreed test seam is declared before execution and RED/GREEN/REFACTOR evidence is present, while final commands are still rerun independently.
criteria.verification_hint: Validate risk-driven task fixtures and runner rejection of missing TDD evidence; keep verification sandbox tests green.

criteria.statement: Future harness refinements remain measurable and safe: checked-in eval manifests reject destructive/remote commands and preserve environment/provider provenance so regressions are visible.
criteria.verification_hint: Run eval unit tests plus baseline/shipping-preflight suites and inspect result provenance.

criteria.statement: Human-in-the-loop escalation is resumable only by an explicit auditable human resolution; resume preserves attempt history, grants no reusable retry authority, and cannot silently weaken accepted task/spec/security boundaries.
criteria.verification_hint: Run harness/orchestrator HITL resume tests; inspect the human-resolution artifact, one-shot grant consumption, trusted feedback classification and rejection of non-escalated resolution.

summary: Independent self-verification criteria for the consolidated Agentic SDD protocol, derived from safety, architecture and existing harness behavior rather than only restating SDD-001 acceptance criteria.
